label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
Mrs. Renee, I am very sorry your toe has been hurting and that you needed urgent care. I mean that sincerely. You have been our customer for two years, and I am sad that you felt I did not care when you came back. I did care, and I still do.

I want to explain a few things calmly, because some details in this thread do not match what happened from my side. When you came back on November 2 and showed me your toe, I offered to refund the full $45 for your deluxe pedicure and also pay your urgent care copay if you brought the receipt. My offer was not only the $45 refund. Both parts of that offer are still open.

You asked for $300 cash and free pedicures for one year. I said no to that request, but I did not take back my offer to refund your pedicure and cover the copay. I understand that being in pain and not being able to wear your shoes is upsetting. I am not saying $45 makes all of that go away.

I also want to speak up for Vy, who did your pedicure on October 24. She is my niece and has been licensed for three years. She was born here in Houston and speaks English. She is shy, but that is not the same as not understanding you. Her account is that you asked her to trim the cuticle more, she expressed concern about trimming too much, and you told her it was fine because that was how you usually had it done. I understand your account is different. I do not want to argue about that here or suggest that your pain is your fault.

For our neighbors reading, I want to explain our cleaning practices too. Our metal tools are sterilized in an autoclave, and the sealed pouches are opened in front of each customer. Every customer gets a new file and buffer to take home, and we use a new plastic tub liner each time. We passed our state inspection in August 2026 with no violations. The inspection report is on our wall.

I opened this salon in 2007 after working for my aunt. In 19 years, this is the first infection complaint we have received. That does not mean I dismiss yours. It does mean it hurts to see people call all nail salons dirty without knowing how we work.

Marisol, thank you for sharing what you have personally seen at our salon and for encouraging us to talk.

Mrs. Renee, please call me at the salon or come in so we can speak directly. I would like to listen and see whether we can resolve this respectfully. The full $45 refund and payment of your urgent care copay with the receipt are still available.

Thu  
Lotus Garden Nails
